title: 第5章 真的有效果第6章 真是太有天赋了
slug: 不过是穿梭万界为啥都管我叫爹
content_zh:
不久前他们还在担心他的弱小，几乎等同于普通小孩。
如今却已经完全改观。
其中一人好奇地询问：“前辈，您现在达到炼精化气了吧？”
童元安疑惑道：“炼精化气？这么说我现在算是在炼精化气了吗？”
那人小心翼翼回道：“前辈，难道您还不清楚自己的境界吗？”
童元安摇头否认，“其实我根本不算啥高人，连这些修炼阶段都搞不清楚呢。”
几人都显得有些尴尬。
显然，现实中的童元安并不像大家想象中那样神通广大。
但即便如此，大家还是热情地分享起了各自对修为的理解。
不过，他们的知识也很有限，基本上就只知道达到炼精化气就可以开碑裂石了。
童元安之前看过不少洪荒传说，大致记得修炼等级的分类情况，明白这还只是初级阶段而已。
于是心中暗下决心：必须继续努力提升自己才能在这世界里生存下去啊！
接下来他又想到了几个可能的发展方向。
第一点，既然身体素质提高了，那也可以试着多吃一些妖兽的肉来补充能量。
第二点，既然发现功德有用，那就想办法多赚些功德。
他还考虑过，要想快速进步就必须拥有相应的法门才行。
毕竟人类自诞生以来一直缺少专为自己设计的修行体系，这也是导致他们整体实力偏弱的根本原因之一。
据闻最早的那批先民个个都是天生高手；
而后代繁衍出来的族群大多止步于炼精化气层次，
少数幸运儿通过偶然机遇能达到更高级别，

但再往上走的话，没有正确的引导将寸步难行。
所以说，对于整个族群而言找到适合人类修炼的方法至关重要，它关乎到了整个人类社会的命运兴衰。
另外值得注意的是，许多其他生物种类生来便携带有进化天赋，
即使是最普通的妖兽寿命也远超常人，
这一点上，人类明显处于劣势之中。
而且它们天生就能吸收自然的能量，直到智慧觉醒，进入更高的修炼层次。
这些优点都是普通人无法比拟的。
只是童元安现在就算想拿到修行的方法，也没有门路。
如果那么容易得到，人类早就不一样了。
不过，童元安想到一个点子：地球上那些功法，在这里不知道有没有用呢？
要知道，中华大地上传下来不少武术。
其中最出名的就是《太极拳》！
正好，童元安以前对武术很感兴趣，学过《太极拳》。
虽然在地球上这套拳法主要是用来健身，但这里是不一样的地方啊！
没准在这里真能派上用场？
想到这，童元安心痒痒的就想立刻试一试。
他回头看了眼铜木正在带领众人热火朝天做着推车。
看来一时半会儿他们是不会停下的。
“嗖！”
童元安跳到了一辆车上。

之前车子被某种力量改造成了法宝，并且已经认定了他是主人。
然后，他开始按照《太极拳》的呼吸方法练了起来。
没错，《太极拳》不仅仅是招式动作，还包含了多种内容，比如太极套路、太极器械、太极擒拿等等。
童元安以前钻研过太极吐纳的方法。
只可惜当时效果不大，他就没有继续练习下去。
content_en:
Not long ago, they were worried about his weakness, almost equivalent to that of an ordinary child.
Now it has completely changed.
One of them asked curiously: "Senior, have you reached the stage of refining qi now?"
Tong Yuanan asked in confusion: "Refining Qi? So I am refining Qi now?"
The man replied cautiously: "Senior, don't you still know your own realm?"
Tong Yuanan shook his head and denied, "Actually, I'm not an expert at all. I can't even understand these stages of cultivation."
Several people seemed a little embarrassed.
Obviously, Tong Yuanan in reality is not as powerful as everyone imagined.
But even so, everyone still enthusiastically shared their understanding of cultivation.
However, their knowledge is also very limited. Basically, they only know that they can open monuments and crack stones after refining the gas.
Tong Yuanan had read many ancient legends before, roughly remembered the classification of cultivation levels, and understood that this was only the initial stage.
So I secretly made up my mind: I must continue to work hard to improve myself in order to survive in this world!
Next, he thought of several possible development directions.
First point, since your physical fitness has improved, you can also try to eat more monster meat to replenish energy.
Second point, since you find that merit is useful, then find a way to earn more merit.
He also considered that if he wanted to make rapid progress, he must have the corresponding method.
After all, human beings have lacked a cultivation system designed specifically for themselves since their birth, which is one of the fundamental reasons why their overall strength is weak.
It is said that the earliest ancestors were all born masters;
However, most of the ethnic groups produced by future generations stop at the level of refining Qi.
A lucky few can reach higher levels through chance,
But if you go further up, it will be difficult to move forward without correct guidance.
Therefore, it is very important for the entire ethnic group to find a method suitable for human cultivation. It is related to the rise and fall of the fate of the entire human society.
It is also worth noting that many other species of organisms are born with evolutionary gifts,
Even the most common monsters have a lifespan far longer than that of ordinary people.
At this point, humans are clearly at a disadvantage.
Moreover, they are born with the ability to absorb natural energy until their wisdom awakens and they enter a higher level of cultivation.
These advantages are unmatched by ordinary people.
It's just that even if Tong Yuanan wants to get the method of cultivation, he has no way.
If it were that easy to obtain, humans would be different long ago.
However, Tong Yuanan came up with an idea: Are those skills on Earth useful here?
You know, there are many martial arts handed down from the land of China.
The most famous one is "Tai Chi"!
It just so happened that Tong Yuanan had been very interested in martial arts before and had learned Tai Chi.
Although this boxing method is mainly used for fitness on earth, it is a different place here!
Maybe it could really come in handy here?
Thinking of this, Tong Yuan'an felt itchy and wanted to give it a try immediately.
He looked back and saw that Tongmu was leading the crowd to push the cart enthusiastically.
It looks like they won't stop for a while.
"Whoosh!"
Tong Yuanan jumped onto a car.
The car had been transformed into a magic weapon by some kind of power, and he had been identified as the owner.
Then, he began to practice according to the breathing method of "Tai Chi".
That's right, "Tai Chi" is not just about moves, but also includes a variety of content, such as Tai Chi routines, Tai Chi equipment, Tai Chi grappling, etc.
Tong Yuanan has studied Tai Chi breathing methods before.
It was a pity that the effect was not great at the time, so he did not continue practicing.
